title: Headless Crazy, Crazy, Crazy (VMS57): Neil's warning at Black Mountain (10) to Tabitha's death (100, complete)

actions.text: Path: Neil, at the foot of Black Mountain, greets the player (0x000E6CA6) and tells of the danger up the mountain (BMNeilAskDanger, end script: 10); the player climbs to the summit and kills Tabitha, whose OnDeath block (BMTabithaScript) completes objective 10 and sets 100 (Complete Quest, 1000 XP). The peaceful ends (Rhonda repaired, Tabitha leaving: BMTabithaYesRhonda and the Tabitha topics) are not walked. Stand-ins: travel by move_player; the climb past the Nightkin and the fight with Tabitha by kill.
Stand-in for the climb to the summit and the fight with Tabitha.
